verdict.rationale: Alma publishes a public visa-guides library covering O-1A, H-1B, O-1B and EB-1 eligibility and process. It also has a founder-specific O-1A guide that explains self-sponsorship, U.S. Agent petitioners and entity structuring to avoid RFEs, a dated International Entrepreneur Rule explainer with the 2025 parole fee change, and a startup-founder visa-options article, all at plain public URLs with no sign of gating. Missing for 10: real case examples or worked walkthroughs, explicit confirmation that the guides are ungated rather than funnels to consultation booking, and independent corroboration of how deep the guides go.
